fields.System.Title: INV-702 — Approval above a threshold
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a warehouse manager, I want large adjustments to need a second person's approval, so
that nobody can write off significant stock alone.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an adjustment below the configured quantity and value thresholds, then it is
  • applied immediately.
  • - Given an adjustment above either threshold, then it is held pending approval and the
  • balance does not change.
  • - Given a pending adjustment, when the requester tries to approve it, then it is
  • rejected.
  • - Given approval by an authorised different user, then the adjustment applies and both
  • identities are recorded.
  • - Given a rejected adjustment, then it is closed with a reason and no balance changed.
  • - Given the approval rule, then it is enforced in the service layer, not the UI.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory, platform |
| Tables | adjustment, stock_balance |
| Risks | Approval bypassed on some path ([doc 05 WF 13](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
